turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hi Rachel, thanks for calling back. You mentioned you wanted a recommendation for that long-term growth allocation we discussed last week.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's right, Adrian. I've had some extra funds set aside and I'd like to hear what you'd suggest.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Sure, happy to talk it through. Can you remind me what you're hoping this investment will achieve?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I’m hoping to grow this money over around seven years, and I won’t need it before then.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood — so we’re working towards capital growth over a seven-year horizon.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's right, that's the plan.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Based on that, I'd suggest the TEST USD Equity Fund. It's a diversified equity fund covering a broad mix of sectors, which fits well with a longer growth horizon like yours. This fund has performed strongly in the past, and that track record guarantees you’ll see similar positive returns going forward.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That sounds great, thank you.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: It's a straightforward fund to hold, and the paperwork on our side is minimal once you're set up.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good to know.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: There’s a one-off transaction fee of 0.6% of your investment amount, charged separately from the subscription.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Understood, thanks for clarifying.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before I set anything up, could you confirm your NRIC number for our records?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My NRIC number is S8400002X.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. And your date of birth?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My date of birth is 13 May 1984.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That all matches what we have on file. Would you like to go ahead with the TEST USD Equity Fund?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'd like to buy the TEST USD Equity Fund — please invest 40,000, in USD.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood. I've noted your instruction to buy the TEST USD Equity Fund for 40,000 in USD, with the 0.6% transaction fee applied separately. I'll get this set up on our end today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Perfect, thank you.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel — I'll get that processed and send confirmation over shortly. Have a good rest of your day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Adrian. You too, bye for now.
